explanation: Carry the allowed inclusive value range down the tree. A left child inherits an upper bound at its parent’s value; a right child inherits a lower bound there. Inclusive bounds preserve this corpus’s rule that duplicate keys may occur on either side.
spaceComplexity: O(h) auxiliary stack space for height h.
